title: Diameter Pay Raises $10 Million to Expand Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure
message_html: Diameter Pay Raises $10 Million to Expand Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure ...
snippet: Diameter Pay has reportedly raised $10 million in a Series A funding round as the stablecoin payments infrastructure provider looks to expand its banking, payments and digital asset capabilities.
